    • Time

      private static void Time()
      time calcs and such, this is the main time method. user chooses a number from a list, its tested if its a real number. If it is, make it book. if book also matches parameters, the code exits the loop.

    • validateDate

      private static LocalDate validateDate()
      validates the due date and prepares it for use. This is only used once, to make sure the user types a correct date. Uses LocalDate

    • timeCalcs

      private static double timeCalcs(int book, boolean countWeekend)
      does the calcs for Time(). This method finds the amount of pages left, and divides it by the amount of days between two dates.
      Parameters:
      book - the index of the book, will be found in books.
      countWeekend - a boolean, is true if weekend should be counted when doing day calculations.
      See Also:

    • PrintB

      private static int PrintB()
      only displays 23 books at one time, consistent increments. Will pause the display at 23 so you can choose a book you see at the current moment. if it is paused, and you type a number on screen, it returns that number. Prints books, as well as the percent complete. Maybe in a later version I'll add settings that can turn off percents, and features like that.
      See Also:
      • BookArray
      • ListB()
